# PR #3322: Patch: daily super run failed

Closes #3308

All three jobs that failed in super run 42238953974 now pass when I run them locally. Every change follows the plan as written. No test, bound or count was skipped, loosened or edited beyond what the plan names.

## `fuzz (3/4)`: handicapped seed 7089

**Cause.** The engine was right; the I2 "extra attack" check in the test-only invariant monitor was wrong. In seed 7089, one `attack` action ends p1's turn. Stinkyscape #47's autopilot then plays two whole turns inside that one action. During them, Drone Corvette `c77` draws Windfury when it arrives, attacks twice (legal), dies, and comes back by Reborn under the same id with a new draw. The monitor only read the keywords of the card left on the field at the end, which was the Reborn body without Windfury, so it flagged the first body's second attack.

**Fix** (`crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`):
- `note_drawn_windfury` takes a new `back_later` flag, true when the same id is summoned again later in the action's events.
- A card that draws its keywords as it arrives and is back on the field by the action's end now gets the same benefit of the doubt as one that is gone by then.
- Only test code changes, so play, replays and hashes are unaffected.

**Tests** (`crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs`): two new `r636_` tests share one helper. The Corvette case passes. The control case, a plain unit with no drawn keywords, still reports exactly one `I2 extra attack`.

**Checked with:**
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 7089 --seeds 1 --handicap` → `seeds 7089..7089: 1 passed, 0 failed`. The release build compiled this worktree's own engine.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards r636_` → 15 passed.
- With the old monitor put back, the Corvette test fails with `I2 extra attack: c1 (stinkyscape-t-drone-corvette, p1's) declared attack number 2 on turn 9 …`.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards cross::invariants` → 74 passed.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit invariant` → 34 passed.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' windfury` → 9 passed.
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` → 200 passed, 0 invariant violations.

## `e2e (6/8)`: specs 07 and 17

#3125 changed two cards these specs relied on:
- **Spec 07:** Pointmaster is now 6/1, so `GRINDERS` in `07-my-pawn-ai.cy.ts` now expects attack 6 instead of 7.
- **Spec 17:** KY's Trial now costs 2, so p1 could not cast it on turn 1. In `17-live-a.json` the seat's `manaBonus` goes from 0 to 1, and the description says why. Bonus mana draws nothing at random, so the deal the seed was tuned on is unchanged.

**Checked with:** the release `jackioh-server` (`E2E=1`), `pnpm --dir apps/web build:e2e` served by `vite preview` on port 5173, then `E2E=1 pnpm exec cypress run --browser chrome --spec "$(node scripts/shard-specs.mjs 6 8),…46…,…47…"`. All 10 specs passed (105/105 tests): the 8 shard-6 specs, plus 46 (menus fit one screen) and 47 (tap areas), which cover the deck builder on a phone. Spec 30 looks for the `jackioh` binary in the repo's `target/`, so I linked it there for the run and removed the link afterwards.

## `e2e component (chrome)`

- **`card-faces.cy.tsx`:** two lists were built through the WebAssembly face model while Cypress was still collecting the file. That happens before the module loads, so the whole spec died with "the engine is not loaded". Both lists (`FAN_DEFS`, `ENTRIES`) are now built in `before` hooks; their contents are unchanged.
- **`deckbuilder-layout.cy.tsx`:** #3243's two-row phone top bar made the deck builder's header 25 px taller, which pushed the pool's first row to 863 px against the 844 bound. Three phone-only CSS changes win the height back. Each uses a spacing token and sits in an existing `max-width: 760px` block:
  - The portrait button's `padding: 0` rule never applied, because `index.css`'s `.app-shell button` rule outranked it. It is now scoped `.deckbuilder.app-shell`, as the file's header says every button rule should be.
  - The workshop header gets a tighter padding, scoped `.deckbuilder.workshop` so the Almanac's header keeps its padding.
  - The gap in the phone deck editor's layout goes from 14 px to 10 px.

**Checked with:** `CI=true pnpm --dir e2e exec cypress run --component --browser chrome --spec cypress/component/card-faces.cy.tsx,cypress/component/deckbuilder-layout.cy.tsx`. `card-faces` passed 26/26, where no test ran before. `deckbuilder-layout` passed 21/21, including the 390x844 first-row test, with its 844 bound untouched. I did not log the exact measured bottom; the planner expected about 838 px.

## Other checks run
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check` and `cargo jackioh patches check`: all ok.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` → `Internal`, so no patch fragment is needed.
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-cards --all-targets --features jackioh-engine/testkit -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The web's CSS and layout unit tests (`spacing`, `breakpoints`, `top-bar`, `browse`, `palette`, `motion`): 105 passed.
- `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck` (43 deck fixtures OK), `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component` and `pnpm exec eslint e2e apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder`: clean.

**Not run here:** the workspace-wide `cargo test` and `cargo clippy` (the harness runs both), the other 39 component specs, the e2e shards other than 6, and the rest of the shard-3 fuzz waves. Only `deckbuilder-layout.cy.tsx` mounts the deck builder. The planner ran the other waves at the planner's base and only seed 7089 failed. Since this change only makes the check more lenient, it cannot add a new failure.

## Decisions the issue did not settle
- **No fuzz-corpus record for seed 7089.** The corpus README says the handicapped wave has no corpus: its records replay only the plain 1v1 deal.
- **The new leniency only counts a later `summoned` of the same id.** I considered also counting a card played again from the hand, and rejected it. A token cannot go back to the hand, and a card arriving from the hand never reaches this keyword-drawing check, so that case is out of this fix's reach.

- `17-live-a.json` no longer matches TUTORIAL_HUMAN's handicap exactly: its mana bonus is now 1, and its description says so.
